summary: Comprehensive backend + focused frontend testing of ECP Project Management & Lead Tracking app. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass covering auth for all 7 seeded roles, lead RBAC + all 5 actions with validation, site visit assign/complete return-to-lead, escalation & owner return, LOST reopen (OWNER only), full ECP pipeline REGISTRATION_1 -> ACCOUNTS_1 -> DISPATCH (payment gate + task-before-start gate) -> INSTALLATION -> NET_METERING -> REGISTRATION_2 -> ACCOUNTS_2 -> COMPLETED (final payment NOT required), financing NO->YES no-regress, closure RBAC/OTHER-remarks/re-close-block, payments RBAC + FIRST/FINAL uniqueness + ADDITIONAL multiplicity + monitor RBAC, SLA owner-only, dashboards for every role. Frontend: Owner dashboard renders and stat cards drill down to filtered lists. Lead role can create a lead, sees 5 action buttons, past follow-up rejected with correct toast, YES qualifies lead and links an ECP. Accounts can create a payment via Payment Monitor (ADDITIONAL CONFIRMED saved and rendered).

issues: Benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' errors are surfaced by the CRA dev error overlay after opening/closing Radix dialogs/selects. Not a functional bug (all flows succeed) but noisy in UX; consider disabling the dev overlay or suppressing ResizeObserver loop errors.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress or fix the ResizeObserver loop overlay noise in the CRA dev build (e.g., custom window.onerror handler).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1050 lines — single-file backend. As Phase 2 grows, split into routers (auth/leads/ecps/payments/dashboard) for maintainability.

OWNER can currently invoke POST /api/leads/{id}/action (LEAD or OWNER). Spec section D states 'Owner CANNOT decide YES/NO/FOLLOW-UP/SITE_VISIT on Lead Team's behalf'. Consider restricting lead_action to LEAD only (OWNER should only be able to /reopen and /escalations/return).

_advance_stage on final step sets current_stage back to 'ACCOUNTS_2' with status COMPLETED. That works but is a bit surprising; consider adding an explicit COMPLETED stage or a separate flag to avoid derived-status/filter bugs later.

list_leads returns [] for non-LEAD/OWNER/MANAGER roles. That silently hides leads for ACCOUNTS/DISPATCH/INSTALLATION/REGISTRATION which per spec should still see 'basic read-only ECP info' — currently they get nothing from /api/leads but do get /ecps for their scope, which is acceptable but worth documenting.

list_ecps ignores 'stage' filter for scoped roles (REGISTRATION/DISPATCH/INSTALLATION) — good, but /ecps?stage=X clicked from a role that doesn't map may return an empty list; add a friendlier empty-state message on the frontend.
No dedicated GET /api/site-visits/{id} — the frontend has to list all and filter. Not blocking.
No pagination on any list endpoint (leads/ecps/payments/monitor). Fine for V1, but the .to_list(3000/5000) caps will silently truncate at scale.
